name: cluster
summary: Arranges peer content in a wrapping horizontal group.

agent.useWhen: Peer controls or short regions should share a horizontal row and wrap on narrow screens.
agent.avoidWhen: Content needs a vertical reading flow or a fixed track layout.

invariants: Defaults to wrapping, centered alignment, start justification, and compact gap.
Gap and alignment only affect direct admitted children.
The component does not create navigation, commands, keyboard behavior, or JavaScript.
